title: Photo contest night: entrant on a phone, then a friend voting from a share link
description: Two phone-sized personas walk a live extrachill/photo-contest page. (1) An entrant at the venue enters with email, name, Instagram handle and a camera-roll photo through the real multipart upload and the Turnstile-guarded extrachill/v1 submit route, then lands on the share panel with their personal link and in-person QR. (2) A friend, at the venue or not, opens an entrant's personal share link, votes with an email, cannot double-vote, then taps 'See all entries' and votes for a second costume with the remembered email. The grade checks REST answers, stored entries and vote counts against what each persona saw.
